name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA (v1.0), capturing the business terms such as purpose, effective date, MNDA term, term of confidentiality, governing law and jurisdiction, plus signature blocks. Incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms by reference.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Standard Terms
description: Common Paper Mutual NDA Standard Terms (v1.0) governing how two parties may share and must protect each other's confidential information when evaluating or pursuing a business relationship.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement Standard Terms (v3.0) for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, restrictions, payment, privacy and security, warranties, liability, indemnification and term.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement Standard Terms (v2.0), used alongside the Cloud Service Agreement to define target uptime and response times, how they are calculated, and the service credits and termination rights available when they are missed.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement Standard Terms setting out how a provider processes customer personal data as a processor or subprocessor, including security, subprocessors, data subject requests, security incidents and international transfers (GDPR, UK and Swiss requirements).

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper Design Partner Agreement Standard Terms giving an early user access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a design partner program.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper Professional Services Agreement Standard Terms for engaging a provider to perform services and produce deliverables under statements of work (SOWs), covering payment, IP ownership, warranties, liability and termination.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper Partnership Agreement Standard Terms (v1.0) for business partnerships between two companies, covering each party's obligations, fees, trademark licensing, escalation procedures, confidentiality, liability and indemnification.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper Business Associate Agreement Standard Terms (v1.0) setting out HIPAA obligations for a provider that creates, receives, maintains or transmits protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper Software License Agreement Standard Terms (v1.1) for licensing software that the customer installs on systems it owns or controls, covering the license grant, restrictions, support, payment, warranties, liability and indemnification.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper Pilot Agreement Standard Terms (v1.1) for a short-term trial or evaluation that lets a prospective customer test a product before committing to a full commercial agreement.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper AI Addendum Standard Terms (v1.0) supplementing a commercial agreement with terms for AI services, including ownership and use of inputs and outputs, restrictions on training models with customer data, and AI-specific disclaimers.
